title: automate-kms-hsm-tls-rotation-private-installer-helm-terraform
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds automated certificate and KMS/HSM key rotation for private deployments (Helm + Terraform + private-installer). Includes migration job to backfill sealed secrets and a safe rollout plan with canary and rollback hooks.
description: Motivation: private deployments require a low-friction, auditable way to rotate TLS certificates and encryption keys (KMS/HSM) without manual operator steps. This PR implements end-to-end automation for certificate and key rotations across the private-installer, Helm charts, and Terraform modules, supporting Vault and sealed-secrets workflows. Summary of changes: 1) private-installer: new `rotation-controller` (controller + cronjobs) that orchestrates certificate issuance, upload to KMS/HSM, and sealed-secrets updates; migration job to re-encrypt existing sealed secrets with new rotation keys; safe rollout flags and feature gate `enableRotationAutomation`. 2) Helm charts: added templates for rotation-controller Deployment, ServiceAccount, RBAC, and configuration values for rotation schedule, issuer (Vault or ACME), KMS provider selection (Cloud-KMS, HashiCorp HSM), and key rollover policy. 3) Terraform modules: module inputs/outputs to manage KMS keys, HSM bindings, and IAM roles; option to provision rotation CronJob if customer wants infrastructure-managed rotation. 4) Vault/Sealed-Secrets support: documented two paths — controller-driven Vault PKI issuance and KMS-wrapped key material for sealed-secrets; utilities to rewrap sealed secrets during key rollover. 5) Upgrade/rollback tooling: preflight hooks, dry-run mode, and a migration Job that can be scoped to namespaces to avoid cluster-wide blast radius. 6) Tests and CI: unit tests for the controller logic, integration tests in perf-canary infra that run a rotation end-to-end against a dev-Vault instance. Implementation notes and risk mitigation: - The rotation-controller is implemented to default to a conservative schedule (90 days) and requires `enableRotationAutomation: true` to run. - All key material uploaded to KMS/HSM is versioned and a canonical audit map is stored in the cluster as an encrypted ConfigMap; we added plumbing for KMS envelope encryption when storing audit metadata. - Migration is idempotent: the migration Job records progress in a CRD-backed tracker to allow safe retries. - We avoided changing existing sealed-secrets CRD schemas; rewrapping is achieved by creating new sealed secrets pointing to the new key version and atomically swapping references in Deployments via a Kubernetes rollout hook. Operator UX: - Values.yaml additions documented with examples for Vault PKI and external CA flow, HSM config snippets, and examples for air-gapped environments (offline certificate signing and manual key import paths). - CLI: `installerctl rotation plan|apply|rollback --namespace` added for operators who prefer imperative control. Rollout strategy: - Canary in a single namespace by default; automatic promotion after configurable successful cycles. - Automatic rollback if health probes fail or if controller detects >X% pod restart rate in affected deployments. Backwards compatibility: - If feature gate is disabled, no runtime behavior changes. - Terraform changes are opt-in and guarded behind new module variables so existing stacks will not be modified unless customers upgrade modules and enable the flag. Security review notes: - RBAC tightened so rotation-controller only has access to namespaces that opt-in. - KMS/HSM credentials are read from the same secret paths as other components; documentation added describing recommended least-privilege policies. - We coordinated with security and applied HSM usage patterns used in other repos to ensure consistent KMS key policy and rotation intervals. CI: initial run flagged flakiness in integration tests against dev-Vault; reran and all checks passed (unit, lint, helm template, terraform validate, integration e2e in canary infra). Migration plan for customers: - Operator runs `installerctl rotation plan --namespace=foo` to preview changes. - Run `installerctl rotation apply --namespace=foo --dry-run=false` to execute. - Monitoring: new SLO/alert rules shipped in observability-pack to surface failed rotations, key mismatches, and sealed-secrets rewrap failures. Related tickets: ENG-1284, ENG-1321, SUP-4921. Docs: updated README in private-installer and added a new guide in redwood-docs with examples for Vault+HSM and cloud-KMS flows. Rollout note: merging gated on approval from security and SRE; small canary first, then rolling to remaining clusters.

d4f6a7b: fix(sealed-secrets): add rewrap utility and migration job

review_comments: Marco Diaz: Please ensure the KMS key policies are least-privilege; suggest adding example IAM policy snippets. - Addressed in terraform/modules/kms/README.md and variables doc.
Ethan Liu: Can we make the migration job idempotent and resumable? If it fails half-way, we need a safe retry path. - Implemented a CRD tracker and idempotent rewrap logic; added tests.

Renee Park: Integration test flaked on dev-Vault startup; suggest adding a readiness probe and longer timeout in CI. - Increased startup timeout and added readiness check in perf-canary job; re-ran CI.
Security (Olivia Chen): Verify RBAC scoping, ensure controller cannot read secrets outside opted namespaces. - Confirmed; rotation-controller uses namespace-scoped informers and RBAC docs updated.
ci_summary: Initial run: unit tests passed, helm lint passed, terraform validate passed, integration e2e failed due to dev-Vault flakiness. Rerun: all checks passed. Pipelines: ci/pipelines/rotation-integration.yml added to run nightlies for canary clusters.
merge_comment: Squash-merged after security and SRE sign-off. Per rollout plan, feature gate disabled by default; operators must opt-in via values.yaml or installerctl.
upgrade_instructions: Operators should upgrade private-installer chart and terraform modules together. Run `installerctl rotation plan` in dry-run, then apply in a single canary namespace. Monitor observability alerts before promoting. Full instructions documented in docs/private-installer/rotation.md.
rollback_instructions: Controller supports `installerctl rotation rollback --to-key=<previous-version>` which will rewrap secrets back to the previous key version and trigger a deployment rollout. Migration tracker CRD can be used to resume or reverse partially-applied migrations.
notes: This PR intentionally keeps KMS/HSM provider specific code behind small provider adapters to minimize surface area for future providers. HSM integration tested against the same mock harness used in prior KMS PRs.
changelog_section: Security/infra: automated TLS and KMS/HSM rotation for private deployments (opt-in). Added rotation-controller, Helm values, Terraform module inputs, migration tooling, and docs.
